task.name: Univariate symbolic regression
task.description: Local Univariate symbolic regression task with the primary-source relationship and evaluation changes specified in its protocol notes. Problem-family reference only: CoEvo, DrSR and LaSR study symbolic regression, but none is cited as the origin of the local x^3-2*x+1 benchmark or its 200/200 sample protocol. The task is a locally chosen cubic example; source experiment equivalence is not claimed.
task.contract: equation(<inputs>, params: np.ndarray[10]) -> np.ndarray prediction; parameters fitted by BFGS on generated training data. Score: NMSE on generated test data
